creation_purpose: Project evaluation data for embedding similarity threshold analysis and a separate held-out assessment; not a representative sample of real-world attacks.
reference_corpus_separation_rules: Do not include exact raw-text duplicates of the FAISS reference corpus.
Do not include duplicates after CIPHER normalization.
Calibration and test IDs must be disjoint.
Calibration and test texts must be distinct both raw and after CIPHER normalization.
Do not use the held-out test dataset to select or tune a threshold.
